title: Apple's HomePod is too expensive, too limited, too late to market, and few people are buying it (AAPL)
text: Apple's HomePod is too expensive, too limited, too late to market, and few people are buying it (AAPL) By Jim Edwards Apr 12, 2018, 5:10 am 54 pts Apple has cut manufacturing orders for HomePod. The smart speaker is more expensive than its rivals but has fewer functions. Apple missed the expected Christmas launch date, and now Amazon and Google's speakers are leaving it in the dust.
